hero_kpi_rationale: RevPAR is the primary performance metric in the hotel industry, capturing both pricing (ADR) and occupancy, making it the key driver of franchise profitability and fee revenue.

kpis.name: Revenue Per Available Room
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue generated per available room, combining occupancy rate and average daily rate.
kpis.description: Global RevPAR increased by 2.0% in 2025, driven by a 2.1% rise in average daily rate (ADR). In the United States and Canada, it grew by 2.3% for company-operated properties.
kpis.signal: Solid growth despite a challenging environment.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rooms sold relative to total available.
kpis.description: Occupancy rate in the United States and Canada declined by 0.4 points in 2025, reflecting weaker demand for transient business.
kpis.signal: Slight decline despite stable overall demand.

kpis.name: Average Daily Rate
kpis.explanation: Average price charged per sold room.
kpis.description: ADR increased by 2.9% in the United States and Canada in 2025, supported by strong demand in the luxury segment.
kpis.signal: Prices rising, driven by luxury hotels.

kpis.name: Total System Rooms
kpis.explanation: Total number of rooms across all Marriott properties.
kpis.description: The system had 1,779,936 rooms at the end of 2025, an increase of 73,605 compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Pipeline Rooms
kpis.explanation: Number of rooms planned in hotels under development.
kpis.description: At the end of 2025, approximately 610,000 rooms were in the pipeline, with more than half outside the United States and Canada.

kpis.name: Net Rooms Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual growth in total room count after additions and removals.
kpis.description: Net room growth is expected to reach 4.5 to 5.0% in 2026, up from 2025 levels.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.67 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.718 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 27.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: International RevPAR
kpis.explanation: Growth in revenue per available room in regions outside the United States and Canada.
kpis.description: International RevPAR increased by 5.1% in 2025, driven by Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

kpis.name: Greater China RevPAR
kpis.explanation: Growth in revenue per available room in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan.
kpis.description: Greater China RevPAR increased slightly by 0.4% in 2025, amid an economic slowdown.
kpis.signal: Modest recovery despite challenging macroeconomic conditions.
